answer_1.quote: In this paper, we investigate the LLM-guided conversation from framework design to autobiography interviewing applications.
datasets: A Promised Land by Barack Obama
An Autobiography by Catherine Helen Spence

answer_2.quote: Interviewing Coverage (coverage) is calculated by the date-intersection between E_intw and E_GT ... We define the Precision as the percentage of extracted events that are being verified as correct...

answer_3.quote: We utilize the popular LLM-as-a-judge evaluation to make GPT-4 decide which conversation is better.

answer_4.quote: We also carry out human-involved experiments with 45 participants, prompting them to engage in conversations with GUIDELLM and baseline models. Following these interactions, we gather feedback, preferences, and ratings from the participants.
answer_4.guideline: Participants indicated which model performed better and provided reasoning. The evaluation criteria included fluency, identification, and comfort.
